description: Statistical observations from one ILOSTAT dataflow, filtered by dimension codes (filters, e.g. {"REF_AREA": ["BRA","ARG"], "SEX": "SEX_T"}) and period (start_period/end_period, e.g. "2015"/"2024"). REF_AREA is required, maximum 30 areas per call — for broad panels, split areas into batches and/or paginate by period. Unfiltered dimensions return all their categories. Does not aggregate, convert or otherwise transform values (raw ILOSTAT data only), and does not search indicators (use ilo_search_indicators).

filters.description: Dimension id → code or list of codes (from ilo_list_dimension_values). REF_AREA is required (up to 30 area codes); any other dimension is optional and, left out, returns all of its categories.

REF_AREA.description: Area codes — REQUIRED, at most 30 per call (e.g. ["BRA","ARG"]). Without them the ILO gateway times out (HTTP 504). Discover codes with ilo_list_dimension_values (dimension REF_AREA).

last_n_observations.description: Alternative to periods: only the latest N observations per series

provenance_mode.description: Provenance verbosity: 'concise' (default — source, url, vintage, retrieval date, citation, license) or 'detailed' (full canonical block with dataset, dimension key and notices)

name: ilo_get_data
title: Get ILOSTAT data
